output.summary: The claim was denied because it was filed 120 days after service, exceeding the 90‑day filing limit in clause C‑2026‑TIMELY‑FILING. The following plan lists the missing evidence, next steps, and why prior precedent does not apply.

items.text: Obtain and submit proof that the claim was filed within the 90‑day limit (e.g., dated receipt acknowledgment).
Submit the gathered proof of timely filing to the insurer as a supplemental document and request a review of the denial.
Precedent F‑TIMELY‑180 does not apply because it was based on the 2025 clause (C‑2025‑TIMELY‑FILING); the current policy uses C‑2026‑TIMELY‑FILING, so the prior overturn does not govern.
The claim is flagged by the FILED_LATE gate, meaning the denial has no appeal basis under the current rules.
